source_snapshot.items: DIMM VR over temperature via heat gun
source_snapshot.procedure: On a supported OS system, use a heat gun to raise the configured DIMM VR slowly to TWarning while watching BMC WebUI, then continue slowly to TCritical, collect photos/results and inspect logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor remains in a reasonable range, matches IPMI SDR and WebUI, and SEL records an event when threshold is reached.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; operator applies heat while agent greps OS thermal logs and IPMI SDR; it additionally says protection/throttling should engage although source Criteria do not require throttling.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED; adds target/threshold map, calibrated independent monitor, controlled fixture/rate, two threshold gates and cooling recovery.
source_snapshot.items_direct_xlsx: DIMM VR over temperature via heat gun
source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Setup the system to a standard supported configuration. 2. Boot to OS. 3. Use a heat gun to slowly heat the DIMM VR indicated under Configurations to the TWarning Threshold (Monitor the temperature increase via BMC web interface) 4. Once TWarning Threshold is reached, slowly proceed to add heat until TCritical threshold is reached. (NOTE: If you go too fast you may only trip the TCritical Threshold) 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. Sensor value should be OK in the reasonable range. 2. Sensor value is same as ipmi sdr command and web ui. 3. SEL should have an event log when sensor reach to threshold.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- DIMM VR over temperature via heat gun: verify DIMM VR over-temperature protection by heating the DIMM VR with a heat gun (physical, operator-driven). Agent captures the resulting OS/BMC thermal evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | grep -iE 'thermal|temp|trip|over.temp|throttle'; echo __DIMM_VR_TEMP; ipmitool sdr elist 2>&1 | grep -iE 'temp' | tail -30 2>&1"

old_problem: Resolve Reliability row 12 Wistron-System RAS-00732-V003: approve board/DIMM-VR/sensor/SEL mapping; numerical TWarning/TCritical, hysteresis and WebUI/IPMI/independent-probe tolerance; heat-gun/fixture geometry, ramp/dwell/maximum temperature and aborts; decide whether TCritical crossing and any throttling/protection are required; define assertion/deassertion, cooling, inspection and recovery acceptance.
disposition_reason: A DIMM VR sensor can lag the silicon or package hotspot, while a heat gun creates steep gradients and warms neighboring components. Therefore the BMC reading cannot itself control safe stimulus; a calibrated local probe, fixed geometry and conservative stop boundary are necessary. Equality between WebUI and IPMI usually means the same BMC source and needs a numerical tolerance and timestamp window, not literal simultaneous equality. The source asks to pass TWarning toward TCritical but does not define whether the critical event must be asserted or merely approached. These resolvable engineering inputs support REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION, with no autonomous heating or inferred threshold. The remaining project decision is case-specific: Resolve Reliability row 12 Wistron-System RAS-00732-V003: approve board/DIMM-VR/sensor/SEL mapping; numerical TWarning/TCritical, hysteresis and WebUI/IPMI/independent-probe tolerance; heat-gun/fixture geometry, ramp/dwell/maximum temperature and aborts; decide whether TCritical crossing and any throttling/protection are required; define assertion/deassertion, cooling, inspection and recovery acceptance. ED-16 therefore prohibits executing or declaring PASS until the named vendor authority, isolated target, deterministic oracle and recovery are approved.

test_case.test_name: DIMM VR over temperature via heat gun — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Validate the configured DIMM voltage-regulator temperature sensor through its warning and critical thresholds, confirm BMC WebUI/IPMI agreement and SEL threshold events, and return the assembly safely to its normal thermal range.
required_package: Board/DIMM assembly revision and exact VR/sensor/SEL mapping
Authoritative TWarning/TCritical values, hysteresis and BMC-WebUI/IPMI/independent-probe tolerance
Heat-gun model, nozzle, fixture, distance, angle, ramp rate and maximum dwell/temperature
Ambient/cooling/load configuration, emergency stop/isolation and recovery/deassertion plan
test_case.test_command: A qualified hardware operator positions a controlled heat source at the identified DIMM VR while an independent calibrated probe and the agent's read-only BMC/IPMI telemetry establish temperature-versus-time. Pause at the approved TWarning boundary for event capture; proceed toward TCritical only under separate authorization and a defined stop-before-damage limit, then remove heat, restore cooling and verify sensor deassertion and health.
test_case.expected_result: 1. Sensor value should be OK in the reasonable range. 2. Sensor value is same as ipmi sdr command and web ui. 3. SEL should have an event log when sensor reach to threshold.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS verdict exists yet for DIMM VR over temperature via heat gun. The protected Criteria is `1. Sensor value should be OK in the reasonable range. 2. Sensor value is same as ipmi sdr command and web ui. 3. SEL should have an event log when sensor reach to threshold.`; it becomes enforceable only after resolving: Resolve Reliability row 12 Wistron-System RAS-00732-V003: approve board/DIMM-VR/sensor/SEL mapping; numerical TWarning/TCritical, hysteresis and WebUI/IPMI/independent-probe tolerance; heat-gun/fixture geometry, ramp/dwell/maximum temperature and aborts; decide whether TCritical crossing and any throttling/protection are required; define assertion/deassertion, cooling, inspection and recovery acceptance.
safety_gate: Dedicated SUT with qualified operator, shielding and calibrated independent temperature measurement
Establish sensor agreement before heat and preserve existing logs
Never direct uncontrolled airflow at DIMM, connector, PCB or adjacent device
Stop immediately for rapid rise, disagreement, smoke/odor/noise, discoloration, cooling/power anomaly or limit breach
No automatic retry; cool and inspect fully before any engineer-authorized repeat
expected_evidence: Owner approval, SUT/board/DIMM/VR/sensor identity and annotated target photo
Calibrated probe/heat fixture details and approved limits
Timestamped ambient, independent probe, BMC WebUI and IPMI readings with computed agreement
TWarning and authorized TCritical assertion plus SEL records and hysteresis/deassertion
Heat/cooling timeline, physical inspection, post-test health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The hybrid case is not MANUAL ONLY because automated telemetry correlation is meaningful, but physical heat remains strictly operator-owned and requires explicit confirmation. Missing fixture/threshold inputs block execution, not the review.

source_conflict.reason: `Reasonable range`, interface equality and allowed tolerance are undefined; no numerical TWarning/TCritical, ramp or stop limit is supplied; and Criteria do not say whether both thresholds/events are mandatory even though Procedure instructs heating through both.
